<div class="page-title">
  <div class="section-kicker">Teaching</div>
  <h1>Teaching & supervision</h1>
  <p>Teaching in linguistics, psycholinguistics and cognitive science, with particular emphasis on questions about meaning, language comprehension and experimental reasoning.</p>
</div>

<section class="section">
  <div class="section-copy">
    <h2>Teaching interests</h2>
    <p>My teaching centres on the relationship between linguistic structure and cognition. Topics that recur across teaching and supervision include semantics, sentence processing, psycholinguistics, experimental methods, inference, prediction and memory.</p>
    <p>For prospective graduate students, the <a href="people.html">People</a> page gives the best overview of the kinds of projects that fit my research.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section">
  <div class="section-copy">
    <h2>Current materials</h2>
    <p>Course-specific readings, problem sets and other teaching materials can be added here as needed. The site is intentionally designed so that this section can remain short and low-maintenance rather than becoming a second learning platform.</p>
  </div>
</section>
